replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Walls maps don't need redstone as the YML itself is enough.
To get a download link, put your world folder inside a .rar/.zip file and upload to dropbox/mediafire, then copy the link and paste it in your map post.
You can look up YML examples at maps.avicus.net, in the category 'Walls'.
If you have any problems while making YML, ask me away in skype.
